known_issues: Protected API experimental and default-off; UI has no login or intelligence editing
Actual TLS, trusted proxy and client IP not verified; PostgreSQL production hardening and comprehensive isolation/race testing missing
Evidence references and relationships are analyst assertions, not verified evidence or automatic correlation
Provenance covers supported new operations only; not tamper-resistant
No complete evidence lifecycle, deduplication or live sources; CISA adapter/import/coordinator and manual CLI are not live-verified or scheduled and have no start-sync API or source UI
Audit tamper resistance and retention, automated rate-limit cleanup and key management missing
Only limited synthetic browser smoke tests; Docker, full accessibility, GitHub CI and production restore validation missing
A CISA sync process crash can leave a running attempt until explicitly abandoned
List pagination is not a consistent snapshot; concurrent changes may be missed
Protected transactions serialize per user; throughput and broader deadlock/race coverage not verified; SQLite lacks row-lock concurrency guarantees
Global login throttling can affect all tenants; blocked attempts can still grow audit storage; rate-limit cleanup remains manual
Offline cleanup command requires synchronized clock, database identity verification and operator controls; it is not scheduled or operator-audited

CISA CLI has no strict total deadline (fetch and import have checkpointed budgets but blocking operations and commit are not forcibly interrupted); actual terminal behavior, source compatibility and provider terms remain unverified
Modal focus and Escape smoke-tested in headless Chromium; assistive technology and comprehensive keyboard behavior unverified
Python hash locks tested only on Linux/Python 3.11; Docker and GitHub CI not run; optional tools separately installed
Investigation foundation lacks verified evidence files, reports, UI and tamper-resistant history; older audit records do not include case IDs
Investigation/entity associations are unverified; link and unlink are available only for open cases; no verified file or chain-of-custody lifecycle
Existing case assignees are not automatically cleared if later disabled or demoted (query-time eligibility is exposed); assignments grant no extra permissions
Case notes are unverified, not database-tamper-resistant, have no retention or UI; safely escape text in any future renderer
Demo localization covers selected demo labels and exact-match synthetic fixture text only; other text/data may be English, broader RTL browser validation and native-speaker review missing
Demo contract validation checks shape and explicit synthetic markers, not whether an upstream provider actually fabricated the data; strict schema changes require coordinated deployment
Case-list cursor is a UUID anchor, not a signed filter-bound token; an anchor that no longer matches current filters is rejected, and pagination is not a snapshot
Deleting a case link can invalidate its pagination cursor; restart traversal; pagination is not a snapshot
Synthetic logical restore drill is not encrypted, offsite, scheduled, point-in-time or tested against any deployed production system; no RPO/RTO established
Admin session revocation does not disable the account or rotate credentials; later logins can create sessions and compromised credentials require separate response

Self password change requires the old password and revokes sessions; no forgotten-password recovery, password reuse checks, MFA, password breach checks, or comprehensive credential-compromise recovery; fixed-window throttling permits boundary bursts and account denial
Password-change failed/throttled attempts after initial token check are audited without secrets, but can grow audit storage; preflight attribution is not a locked authorization decision

Session audit target is an application-validated UUID snapshot without a session FK so cleanup can proceed; DB enforces user target but cannot prove session ownership or prevent audit tampering; historical events lack the snapshot
Entity kind-filter pagination checks that the anchor currently matches but is not a signed filter-bound token or a consistent snapshot
Evidence-target audit FKs can prevent evidence reference deletion; previous audit events lack targets and evidence metadata, claimed digests and files remain unverified
Entity-filtered audit omits historical events without entity targets; pagination is not snapshot-consistent and index performance on production-scale data is unmeasured
Entity title search is a bounded literal substring scan, not full-text search; performance and non-ASCII case behavior depend on database/collation; query strings may be logged by intermediaries
Case title search is a literal substring scan; Unicode case behavior and production-scale performance are unverified and query strings may be logged by infrastructure
ASGI conflicting framing rejection cannot resolve HTTP parsing disagreements before ASGI or replace proxy/server limits and request-smuggling review
NVD single-CVE lookup is fixture-tested only; no live verification, NVD sync API, scheduler, UI, API key or deployment-wide rate limiting; checkpointed time budget is not hard cancellation
Prior conversation commit objects are absent from this fresh checkout; preserved restored workspace as snapshot commit a822bab, not reconstructed historic Git commits

NVD importer orders observations by caller collection timestamp, not source modification time; source assertions and collection provenance are unverified. NVD and CISA use separate source-specific entities and are not fused.

NVD manual coordinator uses one running attempt per tenant with explicit abandonment and has no hard cancellation, shared provider-wide rate limit, start-sync endpoint or live/provider-policy verification; a crash may leave a running attempt. Not-found is only the source response for one lookup, not proof of safety.
NVD CLI has only simulated TTY and fixture fetch tests; real terminal/provider behavior unverified. It does not implement a deployment-wide provider rate limiter or hard deadline.
